topic.source_contract: MMO marine-plan, marine-licence and coastal-interface evidence

facts.law: section 58 Marine and Coastal Access Act 2009
facts.guard: marine-plan policy is not a licence or project approval
the regimes are distinct and may all be required
process guidance is not a candidate decision
plan-monitoring performance is not project approval probability

scope_guards: Marine plans guide decisions but are not themselves marine licences or planning permissions.
Marine licensing, marine wildlife licensing and terrestrial planning remain distinct regimes.
A project crossing mean high water or involving land can require evidence from both systems.
Explore Marine Plans and policy maps are discovery tools and not exact consent boundaries.
An application, pre-application discussion or top-tips checklist is not a licence grant.
Licence conditions, exemptions and project parameters require exact current review.
Plan-monitoring statistics are not candidate approval likelihood or delivery evidence.
No score or promotion is written without exact marine location, activity, licence, planning, environmental and title evidence.
